# v1.20.0 — Main, Readings and Diagnostics

The default AlphaESS dashboard now uses three ordinary saved Home Assistant
views, without a custom dashboard or view strategy.

- **Main:** the four-node Solar/Grid–Inverter–Battery/Load flow remains first,
  including its battery charge, health, temperature and work-mode readings.
  All controls, operating settings, schedules and maintenance tiles are on
  this page.
- **Readings:** daily energy, solar strings, battery details, filtered power and
  house-energy estimates move to the second page.
- **Diagnostics:** the existing grouped sensor/fault view is unchanged.

The flow keeps solid tracks, smooth power-dependent dots, signed direction
labels and no EV branch. Native panels stack on phones. Existing dashboard URLs,
view routes and sidebar metadata are preserved. Maintenance tiles open entity
details rather than immediately executing an action.

This stable release includes the saved-dashboard migration and daily accumulator
callback fix introduced in v1.20.0b1. Known default configurations are backed up
before migration; customised, YAML and unrelated dashboards are preserved.
Registry matching supports renamed entities and multiple inverters. Editing the
generated dashboard manually detaches it from automatic registry refreshes.
Device names use Home Assistant's supported registry lookup, avoiding the
deprecated device-mapping access warning on newer Home Assistant versions.

Hillview v11.5 has been reviewed. The existing filter coefficient is already
aligned; control-changing additions remain excluded. Register maps, polling,
dispatch, existing controls and energy calculations are unchanged.

## Installation

Update **AlphaESS Modbus TCP** to **v1.20.0** through HACS, restart Home Assistant,
then refresh the frontend. Beta releases do not need to be enabled.

On a fresh installation, setup creates an admin-only **AlphaESS** dashboard at
`/dashboard-alphaess-native`. An existing recognised **AlphaESS (Beta)** dashboard
is updated in place, retaining its name and permissions; no duplicate is created.
See the saved dashboard guide for migration and rollback.

HACS displays the README for the installed version, so installations still on an
older version may continue showing its older previews until updated. GitHub and
the v1.20.0 README include fresh Main, Readings, Diagnostics and phone previews.

## Validation

Tests cover Home Assistant 2026.10.4/Python 3.14 and 2024.12.5/Python 3.12,
frontend interactions, saved-view ordering and migration protections. Local
Chromium and WebKit checks cover phone, tablet and desktop widths. These checks
do not constitute testing on a physical inverter or iPhone Companion App.
The removed strategy dependency addresses that loading path; unrelated network
or client failures remain possible.

Preview images render the production flow card alongside representative native
panels and example readings. Native card appearance follows the HA version/theme.
